notes.title: We all dream of having a Patron. | v1.2
notes.content:
Hello there pawns!

A new Friday and a new update for ALFRED is a BAD GUY! 

Like a lot of you were expecting and requested, matchmaking is finally here! ːsteamhappyː
With it comes various fixes and additions, but the most notable is the addition of a new good guy role : [b]The Patron[/b]!

What's more, to celebrate the arrival of the Patron, Alfred's founder pack (giving access to all current and future skins) is currently 30% off!

[b]Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*] A new role has been added! The [b]Patron[/b].
[*] Public lobbys are now available to creation. You can join a public lobby by pressing the Lobby list button. You can still create a private lobby to play only with your friends!
[*] On par with the public lobby, you can now chat directly in game by using the new textual chat.
[*] The lobbies now display different maps in the background when the host change them.
[*] Thanks to the new [b]Patron[/b] role, players can now drop D20. Hence a new animation has been added when you loot a D20.
[*] You can now change your in game resolution to "Windowed 1980*1080" & "Windowed 1280*720".
[/list]
[b]Modifications & balancing:[/b]
[list]
[*] Pawns now looks where they are going. (Rip Moonwalk)
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issues on diverse UI screen regarding exotic screen size.
[*] Fixed an issue where players were able to move from the wrong start point after being teleported (earthquake or death).
[*] Fixed an issue where you were able to click your UI dices while being killed by the [b]Reaper[/b], storing them and allowing you to throw more than one die at the start of your turn.
[*] Fixed a problem where connexion issue could let you be stuck on the loading when connecting to a lobby. You will now be send back to the main menu.
[/list]
[b]Known issues:[/b]
[list]
[*] Player disconnects prevent fights from launching. To resolve this for now, everyone will be disconnected when someone is disconnected. This is a temporary fix until we find a way to properly manage player disconnect.
[/list]
As always thank you for our ever gowing community. Keep giving us feedback so that we can futher work on the game, we can't wait to show you what we have planned in the future! Don't forget to join our Discord.

By the way, who's Alfred???

[i]Ivo[/i]

notes.title: Next Alfred update coming soon: Matchmaking and more
notes.content:
Hello there pawns!

This week just a small note to keep you guys updated on what we are working on right now.

First of all, Alfred next update is scheduled to release next week on Friday!

As requested, you will soon be able to open public lobbys, allowing unknow players to join you if they whishes. Rest assured, you will still be able to create private lobbys to play only with people that you know.
We apologize for not bringing this feature sooner, but we had some technical difficulties and decided to launch without it.
This feature is still being tested as we speak and will normally be released with the next week update.

Also, it came to our attention that players with screen resolutions above 1920x1080 experienced problems. We currently working on it and some fixes will be provided in the next week update. Comming with thoses fixes, the settings menu will allow you to chose smaller resolution in "Windowed" mode (At first only 1920x1080 & 1280x720 will be available). Please continue to keep us updated if you are facing any issues.

We have a few more things comming in the next week update, and we can't wait to tell you more about it next week!

In the mean time, thank you again for playing ALFRED is a BAD GUY, we hope that you are having a good time!

[i]Ivo[/i]

notes.title: Alfred has two new playgrounds! | v1.1
notes.content:
Hello there pawns!

The first major update is here thanks to all the feedback we've received the last two weeks. Thank you! 

First of all, many of you have asked us to introduce matchmaking. We've heard your request and will be working on it over the coming months.

Here are the actual changes in this update: 

[b]Additions:[/b] 
[list]
[*] Added a brand new counter for [b]Marc[/b].
[*] Added Sport and Deap Sea skin packs to the shop.
[*] Added a window thanking you for buying the ALFRED is a BAD GUY Founder pack.
[*] Added an option in game customisation to choose a random map from the available maps.
[*] Added the ability to hide the game code when entering it.
[*] Added Boss death sounds.
[*] Added the Alfred is a Bad Guy logo to the main menu.
[*] Added music when the good guys win.
[*] Added a button to join our wonderful Discord.
[*] Added audio fades for better music transitions.
[*] Added particle effects for dice on different surfaces.
[*] Added two new animations when the Boss wins the fight.
[*] Added a pause button in the lobby to access rules and options.
[*] Added animations to player pawns during Boss animations.
[/list]
[b]Modifications & balancing:[/b]
[list]
[*] The board view camera now automatically deactivates when a fight involving you is triggered, or at the start of your turn.
[*] Players eliminated at the meeting are now greyed out in the player list.
[*] Dice now float in water!
[*] Changed [b]Marc's [/b]feedback when he marks someone to better match the number of marks he applies.
[*] Following several playtests, we've decided to slightly increase the power of Lieutenants. They roll one more 4-sided dice than before. They go from rolling 5 dice to 6.
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Lieutenants and minions can now roll ‘1’ on their respective dice (Sorry)
[*] Fixed an issue with the Localization settings that would cause de language to revert back to french when comming back to the main menu.
[*] Fixed an issue when the [b]Reaper[/b] attempts to eliminate [b]Urgle[/b] but gets eliminated at the Meeting before her power activates.
[*] Fixed an issue where the [b]Puppeteer [/b]attempts to control a player, but that same player is eliminated at Meeting before his power activates.
[*] Fixed an issue where when the [b]Puppeteer [/b]was controlling another bad guy player in a fight, the [b]Puppeteer [/b]would not always get his window back to roll his dice.
[*] Fixed an issue in game settings. When the number of bad guys in a game was reset to ‘AUTO’ after playing a game with custom options, the custom options would take precedence.
[*] Fixed a conflict between using a D'g-up and killing a lieutenant, under specific conditions.
[*] Fixed spelling errors in rules and pop-ups. Dyslexic game designer ... ;)
[*] Fixed various issues with boss aggro zones on different maps where the right music was not playing at the right time.
[*] Fixed an issue with [b]Marc [/b]and the minion tile that allowed him to mark the same pawn multiple times. 
[*] Fixed an issue with [b]Marc [/b]which could mark other pawns in the air during earthquakes.
[*] Fixed an issue with the scythe move where you could use your items just before dying.
[*] Fixed an issue on the victory screen that would trigger the defeat scene when the game was won.
[*] Fixed an issue when the [b]Puppeteer [/b]would trigger an earthquake with his target.
[*] Fixed a conflict between the [b]Reaper [/b]and the [b]Puppeteer [/b]when targeting the same person.
[*] Fixed inventory dice amounts, which were not always correct.
[*] Fixed an issue where the [b]Puppeteer's[/b]  target UI was not updating properly.
[*] Sometimes boss battle zone music would play at the start of the game instead of the default map music.
[*] Fixed an issue where lieutenant and boss cameras would not return to their original zoom values.[/list]
[b] Known issues:[/b]
[list]
[*] Player disconnects prevent fights from launching.
[*] Returning to the main menu from the victory screen changes the music for the player still on the victory screen.
[*] When a player is controlled by the [b]Puppeteer [/b]and the [b]Puppeteer [/b]presses the ‘Max’ button, the player's HUD will not update correctly.
[*] The cameras connected to the [b]Puppeteer [/b]do not always follow the controlled player correctly.
[*] The hand feedback of the [b]Puppeteer [/b]does not always follow the controlled player correctly.
[*] When the [b]Puppeteer[/b] sends a player to fight a Lieutenant, the [b]Puppeteer[/b] does not see the players score at the end of the fight.
[/list]

Thank you all for reading this patch notes. Feel free to join our discord to interact directly with the development team or find other players to play with!

By the way, who's Alfred???

[i]Kiba[/i]

notes.title: ALFRED is a BAD GUY - Founder pack!
notes.content:
Hi!

Today we've released the [i]Founder pack[/i]! 

If you decide to purshase it, you will gain access to every skins, present and future, already unlocked for you.
This pack helps us keep developing Alfred further and keep the studio alive ːsteamhappyː . 

We're currently working on futur updates (New maps, roles and more!).

The next skins packs available will be around sports and submarines activities. We're planning on releasing them next week.

Hope you're still enjoying the game, see you soon! ːsteamthumbsupː

[i]Ivo[/i]

notes.title: Alfred is a BAD GUY v1.0.2
notes.content:
Hi!

Weekly update on Alfred, comming with various bug fixes regarding feedback we recieved during the past couple days.

[list]
[*] Increase rotation speed between skins inside the shop.
[*] Added a small player tag on your selected color in the lobby to make it clearer who owns which color.
[*] Added a small locks on unowned skins to make it clearer if you possess a skin or not
[*] Fix an issue while playing as the [i]Puppeteer[/i] and controlling another player. The [i]Puppeteer[/i] was sometimes unable to use items.
[*] Fix an issue where players were able to edit their name, while entering the code to join a lobby, resulting in unexpected behaviours.
[*] The object [i]D'g up[/i] has been temporarily disabled due to various issues with it. Our teams are working hard on it to make it come back as soon as possible.
[/list]

Thanks you again for the feedback, our teams are hard at work to make Alfred a good Bad Guy ;)
Don't forget to join our Discord to report bugs or just to find someone to play with!

Have fun playing!

[i]Ivo[/i]

notes.title: ALFRED is a BAD GUY v1.0.1

[list]

[/list]

Have fun playing !

[i]Ivo[/i]
